settings.q: Can you model our specific unit?
settings.a: Yes. Send drawings or photos and we'll build an accurate branded scale model.

settings.q: Can it open to show the interior?
settings.a: Yes - cutaway and open-side versions are possible to reveal internal equipment.

settings.q: Does it include a display case?
settings.a: Yes, a clear case and wooden base are included.

settings.hero_desc: A scale model of a container datacenter unit - cooling stacks, pipework and container body reproduced in detail with your branding, on a clean display base. A polished way to present a container datacenter product to clients and at exhibitions. The images are of 2 different size container model we made. Pricing and specs are of larger model.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your unit, branding, colours and display case
settings.desc_title: Want to Present Your Container Idea
settings.s1_body: A containerised datacenter is a big product to demonstrate - so we shrink it to a presentation-ready model. Cooling units, the container body and external pipework are reproduced to scale and branded with your identity, mounted on a clean base. The ideal showpiece for client meetings, reception displays and exhibition stands.
settings.case_body: Built as a branded scale model, this containerised datacenter gave the manufacturer a tangible way to present their modular unit - far more engaging than renders alone in client meetings and on the exhibition floor.
settings.case_quote: Clients finally saw the product in three dimensions. It anchors our exhibition stand now.
settings.prov_p: A physical model communicates a modular product's scale and layout instantly - the fastest way to build understanding and confidence with buyers.
